appearances.snippet: So we don't know if it was show faith by works. The timing of this is definitely interesting and we should actually maybe try to find out, right?

records.text: Candace Owens theorized that TPUSA repeatedly praised Michael McCoy after the shooting because they perceived him as a weak link.

appearances.snippet: And so what I think it is, is that they constantly said that because they perceived him as the weak link. They perceived him.

records.text: Owens said Turning Point USA employees told her the organization had been behind attacks against her from the beginning of her post-assassination inquiry.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But what I will say is I found out from employees that they were behind the attacks against me from the very beginning.

links.title: Employees Allege Early TPUSA PR Suppression

records.text: Owens accused online defenders of the post-assassination Turning Point leadership of being paid to repeat the same message.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We literally do not care at all. What everybody is saying on the Internet that is clearly being paid to say the same thing.

links.title: Paid Messaging Would Not Prove Murder Cover-Up

records.text: Turning Point USA's emphasis on Charlie Kirk's Sabbath practice and final book was intended to remind the public how much he loved Israel, as part of a failed psyop.

appearances.snippet: Okay, I've been watching this whole story, spin, and what we're making fun of is that being the first thing that you hit on tour, the idea that he finished this book, that this was his legacy, it's pretty obvious here that you guys are trying to make us just remind us of how much Charlie (Charlie Kirk) loves Israel.

records.text: Turning Point USA sources told the Daily Mail that the succession video was withheld because public release could expose a donor's identity and because the footage might be weaponized even after a good-faith release.
records.speaker: Turning Point USA

appearances.snippet: Oh, they have that in the article as well. And on top of those concerns, the donor who asked the succession question does not want her question and identity revealed to the public, sources within the organization told the Daily Mail.

records.text: Candace Owens says Turning Point USA still had not publicly released the succession video after 46 days of requests, despite having already released its audio.

appearances.snippet: Well, the scandal is now growing because after 46 long days and long nights of us asking Turning Point USA, specifically of us asking Blakey Neff (Blake Neff) to just release the footage.

records.text: Owens said it appeared to her that, if the rigged-microphone theory were correct, Charlie Kirk's audiovisual team would have been involved in the conspiracy, whether knowingly or unwittingly.

appearances.snippet: All right, you guys lock in and happy Wednesday, by the way. So we apparently opened a can of worms this week discussing what appears to me to be the most viable theory pertaining to Charlie Kirk's assassination, that the microphone may have been rigged, at least it's the one that the theory that has the most evidence to support it. But if this were the case, that would suggest obviously that Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s audio and visual team was somehow involved in this.

records.text: Owens said a high-value Turning Point USA donor who attended the Catholic funeral later told other donors in Europe that Charlie Kirk was not buried at the ceremony.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: months following this, so that took place in September, months following this, a very, very high paying donor over at Turning Point USA ran into another set of donors in Europe and relayed the same. She was present at the Catholic funeral mass and she relayed that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was not buried.

verification.notes: The statement attributes a private-event account to an unnamed TPUSA donor and unnamed recipients in Europe. The episode is the primary public record; searches found reporting that the burial location was not public, but no source independently identifies the donor, publishes her account, or establishes what happened to the casket after attendees left. Recorded as attempted/unverifiable.
